description.value: At 15th level, the paladin is capable of turning an otherwise lethal blow and continue the fight. When an attack that inflicts hit point damage from a natural attack, melee weapon, or ranged weapon would reduce the paladin to 0 or fewer hit points, she can make a Fortitude save (DC the attacker's attack roll) to deflect the attack to her armor or shield (light, heavy, or tower shields only), causing it to suffer the damage in her place (apply item hardness as normal). If this would break the character's armor, it gains the broken condition until it is repaired. The paladin cannot use this ability with broken armor or a broken shield. The paladin must be wearing armor or a shield to use this ability.
